t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E14 - Jeremiah Crichton
d: Crichton is left behind in Farscape One when Moya suddenly starbursts as a result of her pregnancy.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E15 - Durka Returns
d: When a Starburst goes badly wrong, Moya collides with a Nebari ship.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E16 - A Human Reaction
st: Farscape: S1 E16 - A Human Reaction
d: When Moya travels to an unstable wormhole that appears to lead to Earth, Crichton leaves on Farscape One in the hopes of returning home.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E17 - Through The Looking Glass
st: Farscape: S1 E17 - Through The Looking Glass
d: Moya tries to starburst to prove to the crew that she still can. It goes slightly wrong though and she gets stuck in starburst.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E18 - A Bug's Life
st: Farscape: S1 E18 - A Bug's Life
d: A peacekeeper ship is approaching Moya, so Crichton and Aeryn pose as peacekeeper officers on a secret mission.
Aeryn has been critically wounded. She needs some tissue samples to heal. The only source is the Secret base the Peacekeeper mentioned.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E20 - The Hidden Memory
st: Farscape: S1 E20 - The Hidden Memory
d: Scorpius attempts to extract the wormhole technology from Crichton's mind, while Aeryn mounts a rescue operation.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E21 - Bone To Be Wild
st: Farscape: S1 E21 - Bone To Be Wild
d: The crew finds a planetoid that's a botanical paradise. Occupied by a scientist and a peaceful girl. But one is a killer.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E22 - Family Ties
d: With death approaching in the form of Peacekeeper search parties, those aboard Moya say their final goodbyes, and share a last feast together.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E1 - Mind The Baby
st: Farscape: S2 E1 - Mind The Baby
d: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them. Their safety depends on Crais, who is nearby in Talyn.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E2 - Vitas Mortis
d: D'Argo takes part in a sacred ritual that helps an old Luxan, an Orican, to survive.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E3 - Taking The Stone
st: Farscape: S2 E3 - Taking The Stone
d: Chiana leaves Moya and goes to 'grave planet' populated by reckless thrill seekers who play dangerous and life-threatening games.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E4 - Crackers Don't Matter
st: Farscape: S2 E4 - Crackers Don't Matter
d: A visitor comes on Moya with a device that could cloak Moya. The crew welcomes him on board, but soon almost everyone is acting paranoid.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E5 - The Way We Weren't
st: Farscape: S2 E5 - The Way We Weren't
d: Chiana discovers a recording with Moya's original Pilot. After seeing the recording and realizing Aeryn was involved, Pilot orders Aeryn to leave Moya

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E6 - Picture If You Will
st: Farscape: S2 E6 - Picture If You Will
d: Chiana buys a picture in a store, which is more than it seems. The picture changes and shows Chiana what will happen to her.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E7 - Home On The Remains
st: Farscape: S2 E7 - Home On The Remains
d: The crew needs food. Zhaan needs to eat meat and starts spewing spores. Only Aeryn seems to have a tolerance for the spores.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E8 - Dream A Little Dream
st: Farscape: S2 E8 - Dream A Little Dream
d: While waiting for Moya to pick their Transport Pod, Zhaan tells Crichton of Moya's adventures after the Gammak base was destroyed.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E9 - Out Of Their Minds
st: Farscape: S2 E9 - Out Of Their Minds
d: An alien ship fires a weapon at Moya. The blast makes it through and causes everyone's consciousness to jump into another body.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E10 - My Three Crichtons
st: Farscape: S2 E10 - My Three Crichtons
d: A strange globe appears on Moya, sucking in Crichton and duplicating him creating two additional people.
